name: ClientFeedbackNpsLoop
tagline: Close the loop on every client survey – NPS, detractor follow-up, actions and client health in one Power Apps app.
description: Complete closed-loop client feedback app for audit, tax, advisory, consulting and law firms. Post-engagement, milestone and annual relationship survey responses become an NPS dashboard and trend, a response inbox, a closed-loop board, client health cards and a follow-up action list – with a detractor follow-up SLA, owners, actions, outcomes, independent close-out, partner permissions and reminders for non-responders. Works instantly in demo mode and connects to collections, Dataverse, SharePoint, Excel, SQL and the Power Pages Web API.
features: NPS gauge with target, 12-month trend, NPS by practice, themes by category
Detractor follow-up SLA with owners, due dates and overdue flags
Follow-up actions with owners, dates and late flags
Outcome required and open actions block resolving
Independent close-out by the client experience team
Reminders for surveys without a reply
Client health with at-risk reasons and score history
Drag & drop loop board with keyboard moves
Bulk acknowledge, assign, remind, no action
Undo, activity log, validation, empty / error / read-only states
controlType: standard (2 controls: ClientFeedbackNpsLoop data-set + ClientFeedbackNpsLoopPortal field)
